pnpmWorkspace:
packages:
  - .

nodeLinker: hoisted
autoInstallPeers: false

# 只解析 Windows x64 的可选二进制包，避免每次 install 都去镜像拉
# linux/darwin/arm 的 sharp 与 agently-cli 变体（那些下载常年 error 23，
# 会把一次 10 秒的安装拖成几分钟，中途被中断就留下半写状态）。
supportedArchitectures:
  os:
    - win32
  cpu:
    - x64
  libc:
    - unknown
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-about-notice@1.4.0
  - dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-fonts@1.4.0
  - dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-fx@1.4.0
  - dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-mascot-avatar@1.4.0
  - dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-media-bridge@1.4.0
  - dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-parallax@1.4.0
  - dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-pet-link@1.4.0
  - dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine@1.4.0
  - dsh-purge@1.2.1
  - dshmarket@1.73.16
  - '@michengai/dsh-archive-manager@1.3.0'
  - '@tt-a1i/archify-dsh@1.1.0'

allowBuilds:
  dsh-purge: true
  dsh-purge@file:../../../Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/dsh-purge-1.1.71/dsh-purge-1.1.71.tgz: true
  dsh-undo-savepoint: true
